summary: Lumen is the sustained foreclosure of every condition for observation or self-location. Persistence now occurs only through the active collapse of distinctions, markers, and asymmetries—including the asymmetry between presence and absence. No internal scaffolding forms; registration registers solely as its own impossibility.
